feature: Head weak point damage and feedback

saved_map_runtime.scope: Saved map/native projectile and blade sweeps against a real configured enemy. AI and pose are frozen by tick controls, combat remains enabled. 10 damage fixture and per-case health restore isolate region damage; no direct resolver contact or HMD input.

rules: Original body capsule is broad phase; skull sphere follows real head/Head world position without imported bone scale.
Contact evidence retains real sphere or individual crescent-box shape; generic legacy contacts remain body hits.
Moving samples classify within the target capsule envelope so high-frequency broad contacts are not incorrectly consumed as torso hits.
Melee frame aggregation only accepts sample paths that physically contacted this target; static blade spans are not extended beyond their authored ends.
Actual collision shape sweep and world visibility reject bonus through obstruction.
Resolver duplicate, damage-protection and dead gates execute before weak-point damage; local paused targets receive no weak-point classification.
Weak-point result is populated only after positive damage, with a snapshotted multiplier before synchronous death delegates.
Desktop main map, desktop laboratory and head-mounted HUD have visible feedback; impact sound uses a distinct 1.45 pitch.

limits: Head weak point is a tunable 13cm gameplay zone, not per-triangle anatomy.
Main-map evidence uses controlled player/AI poses and 10-damage fixtures for actual native sweeps; it is not a human headset playtest.
